messages:
maria: Heads-up — we're seeing ~4x increase in egress error rates for eu-west on route /api/v1/generate. It looks like traffic is being matched to the lower-priority pool due to header precedence rules. I'm going to propose an emergency precedence flip for that route to route by X-Egress-Priority header to the stable pool. Need quick review + rollback plan. /cc @jonathan @kevin

jonathan: Can you paste the query logs? Which matcher fired?

maria: Here's a quick grep from the gateway logs (last 30s):
```
[2026-03-18T14:10:02Z] route match: fallback_pool (matched: header X-Region: eu-west? -> false)
[2026-03-18T14:10:04Z] route match: low_priority_pool (matched: precedence header missing)
```

kevin: Ugh, header-based routing fallback kicks in when X-Egress-Priority header absent. Are we sure clients didn't lose header due to CDN change?

arun: We pushed a CDN edge change ~15m ago. Could be related. Suggest emergency change: add a higher-priority matcher that pins route to stable_pool when header absent and host matches. Quick config snippet to apply via admin API:
```
PATCH /admin/routes/egress-patterns/stable_pin
{
  'matcher': {
    'host': 'api.redwood.ai',
    'path': '/api/v1/generate',
    'headers': [{'name':'X-Egress-Priority','value':'stable','present':false,'negate':false}]
  },
  'action':'route_to:stable_pool',
  'precedence': 1000
}
```

jonathan: That matcher looks okay but we should avoid wide 'present:false'—it might catch legitimate traffic. How about matching absence + client IP range (edge CDN ips) or restrict to host + path for now?

maria: Good call. CDN IPs are 54.240.0.0/12 and 3.208.0.0/12. I'll add ip range in matcher.

infra-bot: NOTE: Applying route changes will cause config reload and ~2s of in-flight drop for existing connections. Proceed with caution.

kevin: Proposed plan:
- 1) Apply restricted high-precedence matcher (host+path+cdn ip + header absent) -> stable_pool
- 2) Monitor 2m for error rate delta and latency
- 3) If stable, expand matcher to just host+path
- 4) If not, rollback remove matcher
Anyone object?

ops-oncall: Sounds good. I'll be on watch during the change window. Set a 10m auto-rollback if errors spike >2x.

maria: Applying now. Curl:

curl -X PATCH 'https://admin.gateway.internal/routes/stable_pin' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' --data-binary @payload.json

maria: ...applied. infra-bot: config-reload started

infra-bot: config-reload completed: version 2026.3.18-1731

jonathan: I see successful matches to stable_pool now, error rate down 70% :tada: 

kevin: Great. Keep monitoring. If stable for 20m we can relax IP restriction.

maria: Noted. Will run canary expansion in 20m.

ops-oncall: Marking this thread for postmortem capture. Please add timeline and root cause after.

jonathan: Root cause immediate: CDN edge started stripping X-Egress-Priority header due to new gzip proxy. Long term: we need heuristics and header validation in gateway.

maria: Filing a task to add header health check and automated fallback that tags affected clients instead of global changes.

arun: Also recommend adding a 'safety toggle' UI in Console to apply these restricted precedence flips with one-click rollback.

maria: Thanks all. Closing monitoring watch — will update if anything changes.
